title: The Place at the Table
passage: The light moved across the table. Mira left a cup beside a folded letter. When she returned, the room looked unchanged, but the place she intended to sit no longer felt like hers.

title: The Sign at the Fork
passage: At the fork, the sign named two places but pointed to neither. I stayed beside it until the footsteps behind me faded. Then the silence seemed less like an answer than another direction.

title: The Box of Relations
passage: The box held a key, a ribbon and a label from an empty drawer. I kept them together, not because they were valuable, but because each changed what the others seemed to mean.
